# Material Icons

Source: [Google material-design-icons](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons), filled Material Icons, 24 px, Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).

| Local name | Upstream source under `src/` |
| --- | --- |
| ic_settings | action/settings/materialicons/24px.svg |
| ic_home | action/home/materialicons/24px.svg |
| ic_default_launcher | hardware/desktop_windows/materialicons/24px.svg |
| ic_apps | navigation/apps/materialicons/24px.svg |
| ic_help | action/help/materialicons/24px.svg |
| ic_info | action/info/materialicons/24px.svg |

The original SVGs are retained here. Android vector drawables in `app/src/main/res/drawable/` preserve the upstream visible path data, omit invisible canvas bounds, and use a theme-matching monochrome fill. No paths were manually redrawn.
